notes.title: Update v1.1 Added - Patch 10/30
notes.notes:
Fixed:
[list]
[*]Bartender rotation bug
[*]Instance where the wrong item is picked up
[*]Flashlight pick up sound effect
[*]Issue with character movement during duck hunt
[*]Wolf death animations
[*]Wolf physics bug
[*]Cutscene bug
[*]Journal bug
[*]Compass sometimes not pointing north 
[/list]

I would like to thank everyone in the steam community who helped clarify these problems and made these updates possible. 

[img]https://pbs.twimg.com/media/DNVPDCPXkAUB9VN.jpg[/img]
